About this item

  • ULTRA LIGHT PERFORMANCE: Experience superior lightweight comfort with responsive ULTRA LIGHT midsole cushioning, perfect for running shoes for men who demand performance
  • SKECHERS COMFORT TECHNOLOGY: Air-Cooled Goga Mat breathable insole provides high-rebound cushioning, making these mens running shoes ideal for extended training sessions
  • ENGINEERED FOR STABILITY: Parametric midsole construction delivers enhanced support and stability, while M-Strike technology ensures efficient stride transitions
  • DURABLE CONSTRUCTION: Athletic mesh and leather overlay upper with secure lace-up design provides lasting durability and a perfect fit for these sneakers for men
  • RELIABLE TRACTION: Flexible traction outsole offers dependable grip and stability on various surfaces, ideal for both running and everyday wear

Product Description

Elevate your running experience with the GO RUN Consistent 2.0 running shoes for men. These performance-driven sneakers feature an athletic mesh upper with leather overlays for enhanced support and durability. The responsive ULTRA LIGHT cushioning and Air-Cooled Goga Mat insole deliver exceptional comfort for your daily runs. With M-Strike technology for efficient stride transitions and a flexible traction outsole, these running shoes for men provide the perfect blend of comfort and performance.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers find these sneakers comfortable, describing them as feeling like walking on thick carpet, with excellent cushioning and arch support that provides great support for everyday wear. They appreciate the perfect fit for wide feet, lightweight design, and appearance, particularly the blue/red color combination. The durability receives mixed feedback - while some say they last longer than expected, others report the soles falling apart after 4 months. Customers find them suitable for walking, with one noting they're great for being on feet all day.

    I’ve owned a lot of running and walking shoes over the years, and these Skechers GO RUN Consistent 2.0 sneakers are some of the most comfortable I’ve worn. The cushioning feels great without being too soft, and the Air-Cooled Goga Mat insole gives really solid support for long walks, workouts, or all-day wear. ([Ubuy Vietnam][1])

    What surprised me most was how lightweight they feel while still providing good stability and traction. The mesh upper keeps my feet cool, and the fit was true to size for me. I also like that they look good enough to wear casually with jeans or athletic gear.

    I’ve used them for walking, treadmill workouts, and everyday errands, and they’ve held up very well so far. Great value for the price, especially compared to more expensive athletic shoes.

    Definitely recommend these if you want a comfortable everyday sneaker that can handle both workouts and daily use.

About this Item

  • ULTRA LIGHT PERFORMANCE: Experience superior lightweight comfort with responsive ULTRA LIGHT midsole cushioning, perfect for running shoes for men who demand performance
  • SKECHERS COMFORT TECHNOLOGY: Air-Cooled Goga Mat breathable insole provides high-rebound cushioning, making these mens running shoes ideal for extended training sessions
  • ENGINEERED FOR STABILITY: Parametric midsole construction delivers enhanced support and stability, while M-Strike technology ensures efficient stride transitions
  • DURABLE CONSTRUCTION: Athletic mesh and leather overlay upper with secure lace-up design provides lasting durability and a perfect fit for these sneakers for men
  • RELIABLE TRACTION: Flexible traction outsole offers dependable grip and stability on various surfaces, ideal for both running and everyday wear

Product Description

Elevate your running performance with the Skechers GO RUN Consistent 2.0 running shoes for men. These versatile mens running shoes feature an athletic mesh and leather overlay upper design with responsive ULTRA LIGHT midsole cushioning. The Air-Cooled Goga Mat insole delivers high-rebound cushioning, while the M-Strike technology ensures smooth transitions from landing to toe-off. Perfect for athletes seeking reliable sneakers for men that combine comfort with performance.
